# Advisories accepted for now, one id per line (GHSA-... or PYSEC-...).
#
# Every entry needs a comment saying why it is accepted and what would close it.
# An entry with no expiry condition is a standing risk, not an ignore -- put
# those in docs/accepted-risks.md as well, so they are reviewed with the rest.
#
# Example:
#   # GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx: only reachable from the CLI path we do not ship.
#   # Closes when <package> 2.4 lands, which drops the vulnerable extra.
